customer_message.body:
Hello

Given the unusual circumstance: I was home on both agreed mornings; The contractor says nobody answered; My door system shows no ring attempt, although its clock may be a few minutes off; this is my fullest current account.

Regarding “uninspected dampness with disputed access at scheduled visits”, my first account covers: the appointment arrival times remains unresolved; for the request “reconcile the access logs, arrange a confirmed appointment, and keep technical causation open”: I currently have only part of the records; on “uninspected dampness with disputed access at scheduled visits”, I feel stressed but will not rush; also unresolved: the access attempts; that is the basis of my request.

My question is: reconcile the access logs, arrange a confirmed appointment, and keep technical causation open; in particular, I need clarity about the access attempts and how the exceptional circumstance changes the route.

I became aware of the problem on 14 January 2025.

Thank you for reviewing carefully; I need a clear reply about the appointment arrival times; Only then will I know what to do.

Best regards
